newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tigon buys firm, cautions shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Tigon buys firm, cautions shareholders.

text.p: Tigon Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired 50 percent of the businesses of Kraus & Steineman and Cape Specialised Boards & Coatings.
Further details will be announced in Tigon's financial results for the year ended January 31, 1997.

Tigon said the effective dates of the acquisitions were prior to its financial year end and may delay the release of Tigon's results. Shareholders were urged to exercise caution in their share dealings until the results are released.
